steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the code and earlier runs it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card, with numbered test cases and hand-checked expected values, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src + resources/estate.edn's :phone-booth entry only; tester: test files only; give le-docteur a new TASKS.md row T-18 and a GDD note that props can be Blender models, the booth first). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check in particular: npm GLTFLoader only parses, and every object added to the scene is rebuilt with the active (kit's) THREE; the GLB loads once per URL; textures keep flipY false and sRGB; material overrides are a pure, tested fn of data; the kit's shared materials are cloned, never mutated; the :look stays as fallback and failures warn once; the booth keeps its click key and sign; no new npm deps; nothing names a person, pet or member in code. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
